findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_bridge_to_earn_tasks, get_xport_messages, orbitpay_info · Private data: get_address_activity, get_transaction, get_bridge_activity, get_token, get_verified_contract, find_tagged_addresses, get_bridge_solvency, list_tokens, get_address_flows, get_address_bridge_to_earn, list_bridge_to_earn_tasks, prepare_bridge_to_earn, orbitpay_info, orbitpay_crosschain_history, orbitpay_economics_series, orbitpay_token_supplies, get_token_prices, get_address_holdings, orbitpay_tags_export, orbitpay_vault · Public sink: prepare_bridge_to_earn, orbitpay_info · Destructive: get_bridge_solvency, get_bridge_solvency_live.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_bridge_to_earn_tasks, get_xport_messages, orbitpay_info · Private data: get_address_activity, get_transaction, get_bridge_activity, get_token, get_verified_contract, find_tagged_addresses, get_bridge_solvency, list_tokens, get_address_flows, get_address_bridge_to_earn, list_bridge_to_earn_tasks, prepare_bridge_to_earn, orbitpay_info, orbitpay_crosschain_history, orbitpay_economics_series, orbitpay_token_supplies, get_token_prices, get_address_holdings, orbitpay_tags_export, orbitpay_vault · Public sink: prepare_bridge_to_earn, orbitpay_info · Destructive: get_bridge_solvency, get_bridge_solvency_live

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
